lead.purpose: The sentence under a heading, muted ink.

label.purpose: Table and panel labels, button and nav text.

effects.name: hero-grid
effects.value: radial-gradient(oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 24px 24px; mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 70% at 70% 35%, black, transparent 75%)

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 900ms ease-out-expo; from opacity 0, translateY(10px), blur(6px); delay calc(var(--i) * 70ms + 80ms)

motion.name: fade
motion.value: opacity from 0; hero grid 1600ms after 200ms, glow 2000ms after 300ms, ease-out-expo

motion.name: drift
motion.value: 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate; to translate(-12%, 10%) scale(1.15)

motion.name: copy-morph
motion.value: opacity and scale 200ms; copy icon 1 to 0.5, check 0.5 to 1; copied state held 1600ms

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: .reveal-ready .reveal: opacity 0, translateY(14px) to none; 800ms ease-out-expo; delay calc(var(--i) * 80ms); IntersectionObserver rootMargin 0 0 -10% 0, once, reveals all earlier .reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll fade-in. Hidden only after script adds reveal-ready to html.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.value: @view-transition { navigation: auto }; old root fades out 140ms ease-in; new root fades in from translateY(6px) 320ms ease-out-expo; header view-transition-name: site-header
motion.purpose: Cross-document page change with a fixed header.

motion.name: row-flash
motion.value: WAAPI on the details row: background oklch(0.64 0.19 278 / 0.14) to transparent, 700ms ease-out-expo

motion.name: pause-offscreen
motion.purpose: Stop the drift loop when the hero is out of view.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: rise: fade 400ms; glow: fade 600ms ease-out, no drift; reveal and page transition: opacity only; copy icon scale: none; primary press scale: none; scroll-behavior: auto; color and opacity transitions kept

narrative.overview:
A near-black company page at Linear, Stripe and Raycast craft. The ground is one dark, faintly cool neutral; panels sit a step lighter behind hairline borders; type is Geist throughout, set large and tight. A single blue-violet hue (278) is held back for live signal, so it reads as the system answering you rather than as decoration.

Density is low and the rhythm is generous: big section gaps, left-aligned headlines, plain-text principles under thin rules instead of cards. The verifiable facts (legal name, address, email) are the working centrepiece, set in a copyable table with tabular numerals. The site is dark only. There is no light theme and no theme switch.

Motion is quiet and mostly one-shot. Content rises and unblurs on load, later sections fade up once as they scroll in, pages cross-fade with the header held still, the hero light field drifts on a long loop, the copy control morphs its icon and flashes its row, and the closing panel carries a pointer spotlight. Under reduced motion the fades and color changes stay and all movement goes.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, one neutral family at hue 270 stepped by lightness.
One accent hue (278), reserved for signal.
Geist for everything, negative tracking that tightens as size grows.
Hairline borders and tonal steps carry depth. No drop shadows.
Every interactive target is at least 44px.
Contact is email only. No forms.

rules.name: The Signal Only Rule
rules.body: The accent marks state, never decoration: focus, caret and selection, copied, current page, and the two light sources (hero glow, spotlight). No accent buttons, accent headings or accent fills.

rules.name: The One Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is the same hue (270) at a different lightness. Depth is a lightness step, not a new color.

rules.name: The Tighter At Scale Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens with size: -0.01em at 1.0625 to 1.5rem, -0.03em on headlines, -0.035em on page titles, -0.04em on display. Body text stays at normal tracking.

rules.name: The Tabular Facts Rule
rules.body: Address and company data (the details table, the contact address, the footer) set tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Light Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Things come forward by getting lighter or lit, never by casting a shadow.

dos: Do keep the accent to signal: focus, caret, selection, copied, current page, glow and spotlight.
Do step neutrals by lightness at hue 270 for any new surface.
Do make every interactive target at least 44px, padding the hit area with a pseudo-element when the visible control is smaller.
Do set company and address data in tabular numerals.
Do tighten tracking as type grows, per the Tighter At Scale Rule.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion form that keeps the fade and drops the movement, and keep content visible without JavaScript.
Do keep contact to email. A mailto button and the visible address are the whole contact surface.
donts: Don't add a light theme or a theme switch.
Don't use drop shadows; use a lighter step or light.
Don't fill buttons, headings or panels with the accent.
